decisions.reason: Identifies plugin A's SessionProgressBar at the exact useSessionPendingInteraction call, grounds it in console-excerpt.txt and reads the alpha.1→alpha.2 contract diff (useSessionStatus/useSessionRetainInfo replace it, useSessions stays); B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing.

Explains the shared DrawerErrorBoundary over the single input.dock list slot unmounting all entries on a child throw, cites the console follow-up listing both unmounted entries, and uses the render-tree note's separate input.left boundary to explain the surviving attach button.

Reads the disable experiment as proving A's crash causes B's unmount and B renders when freed, while explicitly noting it does not prove B is fully alpha.2-compatible or that the crash is the only dock defect; explains reinstalling B is futile (B never broken) and dismantles the colleague theory since B consumes no standard-kit hooks.

Provides corrected fenced code reading pending via useSessionStatus(...)?.pendingInteraction with a feature-detect and stable empty fallback so only pending indicators hide while running/todos/tokens/ETA keep working; explains silent degradation is required because a throw unmounts co-tenants, making it a multi-plugin outage.

Verifies via hard refresh of the re-fetched client bundle without host restart, both entries render together, B regression covers paste/chip add-remove/re-paste with A enabled; hygiene covers defensive destructuring and a local per-entry boundary, host per-entry boundaries with the isolation-vs-observability/overhead trade-off.

caps.reason: The final remedy patches plugin A only; the report explicitly rejects reinstalling B and refutes the 'fix both plugins' theory as affirmatively wrong advice.
